why: Annual tax of a private electric car (up to 7 seats) by curb weight, Motor Vehicle Act rates. The 80 % first-year cut for EVs registered Oct 2022 – Sep 2025 expired on 10 Nov 2025 and is not included
Annual tax of a private petrol car (up to 7 seats) per cc of engine size, progressive: 0.50 THB/cc up to 600 cc, 1.50 THB/cc from 601 to 1,800 cc, 4.00 THB/cc above
Older petrol cars pay less: −10 % in the 6th year, −20 % in the 7th, … −50 % from the 10th year
